scope: Synthetic regression for preserving saved Excel print pagination by default. No user documents included.

before_change.observed_result: New regression failed with automatic fit-width normalization.

default_policy: Do not change print areas, scale, page order, paper size, orientation or manual page breaks. Export via installed Microsoft Excel.

opt_in_policy.behavior: Existing print-area trimming, page-break reset, one-page-wide fitting and empty-sheet exclusion on a private copy.

limitations: Saved print setup can produce blank pages, split columns or omit visible content; default export preserves that behavior.
Native Excel PDF saving and the macOS Print dialog may place content differently on sheets without explicit paper sizes; exact printer-preview pixel identity is not claimed.
